Bug_Title: FI: Finalizer should be protected, not public (FI_PUBLIC_SHOULD_BE_PROTECTED)
Bug_Details:
A class's finalize() method should have protected access,
 not public. finalize()
Bug_Explanation: The finalize() method in the FinalizerBug class is defined as public, which is a bug as it should be protected.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug() method which in turn creates an instance of FinalizerBug and sets it to null, triggering garbage collection. Since the finalize() method of FinalizerBug is public, it can be directly accessed outside the class, which is a violation of the Java specification and will cause the test to fail.
